channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Araghchi ignores Trump, waits for mediators’ response on Hormuz
item.description: Iran says it’s still waiting for an official response from the US on its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran awaits official response as Trump rejects Hormuz plan
item.description: US president rejects Iran's seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, saying the deal is not 'acceptable'.

item.title: Pezeshkian says Iran ‘no longer trusts talks with Washington’
item.description: Iran’s Pezeshkian says Tehran no longer trusts US talks, shortly before Trump rejected its Hormuz proposal.

item.title: Four American tourists among 6 killed in suspected gas leak blast in Athens
item.description: Two women reportedly injured after building collapse in Athens' historic Plaka district.

item.title: Deadly shooting hits Caribbean islands of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
item.description: Four people were killed and four wounded near the capital of Kingstown on the islands, known as a tourism destination.

item.title: Russia scales up strikes on Ukraine as largest steelmaker halts operations
item.description: A wave of Russian strikes has hit various regions across Ukraine.

item.title: Why is violence between Pakistan and Afghanistan recurring?
item.description: Pakistan has carried out new strikes inside Afghanistan.

item.title: Saudi FM accuses Iran of ‘flagrant attacks’ and condemns Houthis at UNGA
item.description: At the UN, Saudi Arabia accused Iran of attacks across the region and called for action against the Houthis.

item.title: Trump rejects Iranian offer to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: US President Donald Trump has rejected Iran’s latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to shipping.

item.title: Iraq seeks US exemption from ban on Iranian flights
item.description: Ali al-Zaidi government urges dialogue to de-escalate regional tensions amid US sanctions on Iranian airlines.
